instructions: Assess only the listed primary candidates in a fresh invocation. Read their dialogue first, then the exact card; use the alternate only to judge meaningful differentiation. Supply six criterion ratings with specific turn evidence and full coach-2.0 findings. Do not invent missing backstory or assume earlier approval. No writer scores or rationales are supplied. Report real reservations and failures. Totals are calculated in code.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

card.title: Designated Reality Check
card.instruction: Return automatically to translating every bizarre development into practical consequences, even when everyone else seems comfortable with it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The fountain's producing wishes. Who empties the bucket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a miracle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Miracles still overflow onto borrowed carpets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can wish the water away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put someone on hourly wishing duty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your floating relatives still need place cards. I'll get string.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're floating through the ceiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need the upstairs seating plan too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. Aunt June can finally avoid Uncle Peter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if they stop on different floors. Which one ordered the vegetarian meal?

card.title: More Committed Than You
card.instruction: Treat belief in the scene’s strangest premise as a contest, proving your commitment through increasingly unnecessary demonstrations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You only bow to our invisible queen? I'm giving her my chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She already has an invisible throne.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine can support her feet. You hadn't considered her comfort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give her my cushion, then. You can sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your cushion. She can have my bed. I'll sleep standing in case she calls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You signed the pledge that the moon hears us? I'll sign with both hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One signature's enough. I'm taking it outside tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll use two pens. She should know which of us means it twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's illegible. She won't know your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write it across my bedsheet. You can carry your little page.

card.title: Your Nonsense Works
card.instruction: Use another person’s strangest reasoning as your most reliable guide while publicly calling each successful result a coincidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your backward walk boiled the kettle. Coincidence. How do I open this cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Compliment it. We need the cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely hinges. Very distinguished grain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. It's open. Now the fridge wants an apology before it'll release the milk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another coincidence. What exactly did I do to the fridge? I want to get this right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your formula says sing to the jammed printer. Payroll needs these now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It likes lullabies. Start softly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sleep, little printer, the stapler is near.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's printing. Keep going until the last payslip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coincidence. Sleep, little printer—write this tune on the troubleshooting sheet before you leave.
